Violet: Heads up — noticed a class of requests where routing fallback didn't show up in decision logs even though the request hit the fallback model.
Sam: Can you paste an example request?
Violet: Yep — here's a sanitized header block from the retry where the route matched a tenant-specific rule but decision logs are empty.
```
GET /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.ai
x-tenant-id: AcmeCorp
x-client-feat: enable-dedicated-route
User-Agent: curl/7.88.1
```
Dana: hm, decision logs are sampled at 1% for high-traffic tenants — might be sampling noise. What sampling config did this tenant have?
Violet: Tenant is default sampling (0.5%). But the odd part: the trace shows a prefilter header transform that lowercased `x-client-feat` -> `x-client-feat` (same) but also stripped `x-tenant-id` into `tenant` header. The route matcher uses `x-tenant-id` exact key.
Kevin: If the prefilter renames the header before the sampler runs, sampler might see a different key and skip logging because it keys sampling on header fingerprint.
lina: Which order do we run things in the gateway today? I thought sampler runs before normalization.
ops-bot: deploy/edge-gateway@canary started 2025-11-07T14:02Z (sha: b9f7d2)
arjun: Historically sampler ran first, but we shipped a perf micro-optim that moved header normalization up into the prefilter to canonicalize routes earlier. Sampler wasn't updated to the new fingerprinting key.
Sam: That matches — found this in the runtime changelog: `prefilter: normalize-headers earlier for fast-match` (Nov 2025).
Violet: So mismatch between fingerprinting key and normalized headers explains why decision logs missing even though route fired. Could be worse: logs may point to wrong tenant.
Dana: Agreed. Options: 1) revert normalization order, 2) update sampler fingerprint to use post-normalized key, 3) add shadow-sampling (log both pre/post) for a week to estimate impact.
Kevin: Revert is simplest short-term but hurts match perf. I prefer shadow-sampling + update fingerprint for correctness.
lina: Shadow-sampling seems safe. We can add a toggle in the console under Routing -> Observability to enable pre/post sampling for a tenant. UX: default off, enable for 24h windows.
Violet: Can someone open a PR to add shadow sampling + a migration to update fingerprint logic? I can take the observability console toggle.
Sam: I'll draft the sampler change (update fingerprint after normalization) and add a feature flag.
arjun: I'll own the canary rollout plan. Propose: enable shadow-sampling for 10% of requests for 24h in canary region, verify decision log overlap >= 99.9% before global rollout.
qa-bot: test/route-eval-shadow-001 created — includes e2e that asserts decision log emits both keys when shadow enabled.
Violet: Filed infra ticket: GH#4821 (routing/sampler: support post-normalize fingerprint + shadow-sampling). Linking logs and example traces in the issue.
Dana: Action items: Sam -> PR for fingerprint update + feature flag; Lina -> console toggle UI + docs; Arjun -> canary plan; Violet -> link traces & monitor dashboards; Kevin -> revert fallback plan if perf regresses.
Sam: ETA for PR tomorrow EOD.
lina: I'll sketch a small console mock and post in #design by EOD as well.
Violet: Thanks all — reassigning to eng-platform triage, will follow up after canary run. :thumbsup:
